item.title: Surveillance of West Nile virus infections in humans and animals in Europe, weekly update
item.description: Since the beginning of the 2026 transmission season and as of 1 October 2026, EU/EEA countries reported 512 locally acquired human cases of West Nile virus infection, including 41 deaths. Cases were reported by Italy, Greece, Romania and Hungary.
